name: MonarchEditorToolbar
title: EditorToolbar
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.FilledTonalIconToggleButton, androidx.compose.material3.FilterChip, androidx.compose.material3.IconButton, androidx.compose.material3.DropdownMenu, androidx.compose.material3.AlertDialog in a horizontally scrolling androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row
summary: A formatting toolbar for a text editor: undo and redo, a text style menu, inline formats, lists, quotes, code and links, plus product tools.
whenToUse: Above a rich text field or above the keyboard while one is focused: notes, comments, documents, email bodies.
whenNotToUse: For a plain text field with no formatting, show no toolbar. For actions on the whole document (share, export), use the top app bar.
api: @Composable fun MonarchEditorToolbar(onAction: (MonarchEditorTool) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, groups: List<List<MonarchEditorTool>> = MonarchEditorTool.DefaultGroups, active: Set<MonarchEditorTool> = emptySet(), disabled: Set<MonarchEditorTool> = emptySet(), enabled: Boolean = true, icons: Map<MonarchEditorTool, Painter> = emptyMap(), labels: MonarchEditorToolbarLabels = MonarchEditorToolbarLabels(), onLink: ((String?) -> Unit)? = null)

class MonarchEditorTool { val id: String; val level: Int?; val title: String?; companion object { val Undo; val Redo; val Paragraph; val Bold; val Italic; val Strikethrough; val Code; val Link; val BulletList; val OrderedList; val TaskList; val Blockquote; val CodeBlock; fun heading(level: Int): MonarchEditorTool; fun custom(id: String, title: String): MonarchEditorTool; val DefaultGroups: List<List<MonarchEditorTool>>; val InlineGroups: List<List<MonarchEditorTool>> } }

class MonarchEditorToolbarLabels(toolbar: String? = null, tools: Map<MonarchEditorTool, String> = emptyMap(), textStyle: String? = null, linkTitle: String? = null, linkAddress: String? = null, linkApply: String? = null, linkRemove: String? = null, linkCancel: String? = null, linkHelp: String? = null)

options.name: onAction
options.description: Runs when a tool is pressed or a text style is chosen. The app applies it to its editor.

options.name: groups
options.description: The tools in groups separated by dividers. Neighbouring paragraph and heading tools become one text style menu; empty groups are dropped. MonarchEditorTool.InlineGroups gives inline formats only.

options.name: active
options.description: The formats that are on at the caret or selection, and the current text style. The app's editor works these out.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Tools that cannot be used now, such as undo with nothing to undo.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether any tool can be used, for example false while the editor loads.

options.name: icons
options.description: The icon of each tool, drawn in the control's content color. A format with an icon is an icon toggle button; without one it is a filter chip with its name.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the toolbar name, every tool name (by tool), the text style menu and the link form.

options.name: onLink
options.description: Makes the link tool open a form for the address. Receives a safe address to apply, or null when Remove link is pressed. Without it, the link tool goes to onAction.

states.name: on
states.description: A format in active is a checked icon toggle (the tonal fill) or a selected filter chip with its check mark.

states.name: disabled tool
states.description: Drawn in the disabled colors, announced as disabled, and cannot be pressed.

states.name: link form
states.description: An AlertDialog with an address field, Apply (enabled only for a safe address), Remove link when a link is active, and Cancel.

states.name: disabled
states.description: With enabled = false every control is disabled.

states.name: narrow
states.description: The row scrolls sideways when the tools do not fit.

appearance: A row on the surface background role with thin dividers in the subtle border role between groups. The controls take the colors Monarch maps to the Material scheme: tonal fill for a checked icon toggle, the selected chip colors for a chip, the ghost MonarchButton for named actions and the text style menu. The same mapping in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web toolbar drives a Tiptap editor directly. Android has no Monarch rich text editor yet, so this toolbar is editor-agnostic: the app passes which formats are on and applies what is pressed. The parity map named a row of icon toggle buttons above the keyboard: Monarch bundles no icons, so the app passes them in icons (a Painter per tool, sized and tinted by the control) and a tool without one shows its name as a FilterChip or ghost button; the placement above the keyboard is the app's, with Modifier.imePadding(). Headings are one text style menu instead of a button per level, to fit a phone. The link popover is an AlertDialog. The web's arrow-key roving focus and shortcut hints are not offered; TalkBack and a hardware keyboard move through each control, and shortcuts belong to the app's text field. iOS uses the same name; its action closure is onAction, and its custom tool's SF Symbol is an entry in icons.
accessibility: The toolbar is a traversal group named "Formatting".
Formats are Material 3 toggles: an icon toggle is read with its name and on or off; a chip is read with its name and selected state. The on state is also a fill or a check mark, not color alone.
Undo, redo and product tools are buttons named by their title.
The text style menu is a button named "Text style" whose state is the current style; its entries show a radio mark and carry the selected state.
Group dividers are hidden from TalkBack.
Every control has a 48dp touch target; icon-only tools are named through their content description.
edgeCases: Empty groups are dropped, so two dividers never meet.
Heading levels outside 1 to 6 become the nearest level.
A link typed as a bare domain becomes https and an email address becomes mailto; javascript, data and other schemes, and text with spaces, are refused and Apply stays disabled.
